title: Reels
description: Short story/reels rail copied from for-stories: circular previews, fullscreen modal playback, image/video segments, progress bars, and CTA modes.

normalization: Blade reads stories:stories_popups and renders the for-stories reels DOM when the collection has items.

runtime: shared modal bridge exposing window.__VGMODALS_INITIALIZED__ and window.Modals.getModal(id)

media.note: Fixture assets mirror for-stories demo assets and are not a CMS contract.

aliases.purpose: No legacy stories/reels runtime aliases are used by this canonical block.

agent.usage: Use this block when the target section should match the for-stories reels implementation and be wrapped by the stories:stories_popups CMS collection check.
transferSteps: For a target project copy section-reels.blade.php, _reels.scss, reels.js, and assets. Do not copy demo.html, _reels.demo.scss, reels.demo.js, or fixture.json unless you need a local preview.
Keep the for-stories DOM classes section-reels and container-reels.
Use the project's existing stories/reels data bootstrap with this Blade view. The demo fixture is registry-only.
Ensure the target modal runtime exposes window.__VGMODALS_INITIALIZED__ and window.Modals.getModal('reels'), or provide an adapter equivalent to the registry modal bridge.
acceptance: section-reels.blade.php keeps the for-stories reels DOM and wraps it with get_collections('stories', 'stories_popups', ...).
_reels.scss is a direct port of for-stories/assets/styles/components/blocks/_reels.scss with only local media mixin definitions changed for registry compilation.
reels.js initializes modules-vg-reels with the same Swiper settings as for-stories/assets/js/index.js.
reels.js does not import fixture.json or registry demo data.
reels.demo.js is the only JS file that imports fixture.json.
_reels.demo.scss is the registry SCSS entry and _reels.scss is the project SCSS entry.
No templates/stories or legacy stories/reels implementation is present in the registry runtime path.
The modal opens through data-modal="reels" and closing stops playback through the modules-vg-reels lifecycle.
Blade renders nothing when stories:stories_popups has no items.
notes: The registry demo continues to use fixture.json through reels.demo.js.
